tasks.short: Design and conduct scientific hydrogeological investigations

steps.what: Read actual water-management questions, existing site evidence and instrument references through native project and site views
inputs: Actual management question and existing site and instrument records
outputs: Verified investigation context

steps.what: Design the actual hydrogeological investigation, choosing hypotheses, sampling locations, methods, quality checks and limits of inference appropriate to the management question
inputs: Actual question, verified site evidence and real resource constraints
outputs: Actual investigation design and measurement specification

steps.what: Conduct the actual permitted investigation, preparing instruments, making observations and obtaining actual water or subsurface measurements and field context
inputs: Actual site, instruments and investigation design
outputs: Actual field observations and instrument readings

steps.what: Capture and verify actual sample or site IDs, depths, datums, dates, units and source files and explicitly map the real readings into the investigation record
inputs: Actual s3 readings and field observations
outputs: Verified reading values and explicit field-to-record mapping

steps.what: Populate unsaved investigation record fields from only the actual verified readings under the explicit site, datum, time and unit mapping
inputs: S4 verified actual readings and explicit mapping
outputs: Proposed actual investigation record and missing-field exceptions

steps.what: Check actual recorded readings against originals, identify quality failures and write the real investigation limitations and follow-up questions
inputs: Actual originals and proposed investigation record
outputs: Checked actual investigation record with quality limitations

steps.what: Save the actual completed record in the same investigation workspace
inputs: Checked completed actual investigation record
outputs: Stored actual investigation record

tasks.design: Use native {OTHER} site views and explicit instrument-to-record mappings in the existing hydrogeological investigation tools, with original references in {DOCS}. The hydrologist designs and conducts the real investigation, captures field identifiers and checks the actual results.
tasks.previous_blocker: Real instrument values may need repeated entry after field collection and mapping.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit instrument fields can populate an existing investigation form deterministically.
tasks.still_hard: The right sampling design and credible field measurements require scientific and physical work.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise when observations cannot answer the management question.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: fixed instrument-field mappings can prepare investigation records; hydrogeological design, fieldwork and quality interpretation remain human work.

assumptions: Representative actual investigation with observed manual re-entry, not a measured mixture of all possible field campaigns. Existing project owners produce prior evidence; s1 counts finding and checking it. S2 counts actual design, s3 actual permitted field collection and s4 actual field/context capture and mapping. No clean measurement feed or free new sampling is assumed.

S5 requires verified site/sample ID, depth and datum, value and unit, date/time, instrument ID and source file. Missing instrument exports remain manual entry. Try native export/form configuration first; existing automatic recording earns no new runtime saving.

This episode uses ordinary permitted observations and sampling. Any real drilling, controlled source use, equipment movement or separate operating commitment must include its actual authority and distinct action before extending the graph; none is assumed completed by the record save.

Actual record writing is split from fieldwork in s4-s6. Ordinary same-system save share1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated, with no saving or self-approval. No report send or water-management decision is hidden in it. Shares are illustrative and independent of prompt priors.
unknowns: Which actual instrument values are re-entered?
Which depth, datum and time fields survive instrument exports?
research_questions: Observe an actual investigation and count scientific design, field collection, context capture, repeated entry and quality documentation separately.

already_counted.description: Actual source checks, investigation design, field collection, context capture and mapping, complete record check and ordinary save remain in s1-s4 and s6-s7.

incremental.description: Maintain instrument and site-field mappings beyond retained investigation checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:10*.10=1 source-navigation point plus5 actual re-entry points less2 upkeep=4. Low: legacy instrument output lacks depth/datum linkage and all5 entry points remain manual; the site view already exists, so no new navigation gain. Keep the existing route without additional mappings or upkeep and claim zero. Design25, fieldwork45, context capture10, check4 and save1 remain. An instrument-provenance compatibility case, unmeasured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Study and document underground and surface water quantities and distribution

steps.what: Collect actual groundwater and surface-water observations, abstraction or development records and relevant maps, verifying sites, periods, units, datums and the explicit aggregation rules
inputs: Actual water observations, existing development records and source maps
outputs: Verified water-study values and explicit spatial/time aggregation contract

steps.what: Assemble the explicitly specified water-quantity and distribution tables and maps and calculate stated totals or differences only across compatible sites, periods and units
inputs: S1 actual verified observations and explicit aggregation, unit and map settings
outputs: Source-linked water tables and maps with period, datum and missing-data exceptions

steps.what: Study actual water quantities, distribution, disposition and development against original evidence and assess uncertainty, coverage and possible explanations
inputs: Original evidence, actual water tables/maps and explicit exceptions
outputs: Actual hydrological findings and limits of inference

steps.what: Document the actual study findings using native checked table and source-reference fields, retaining the hydrologist's explanation and uncertainty
inputs: Actual hydrological findings and checked source/table identifiers
outputs: Actual written water-study documentation

steps.what: Save the actual study documentation in the same document system
inputs: Completed actual study documentation
outputs: Stored water-study documentation

tasks.design: Use {OTHER}, the actual hydrological analysis and mapping tools, to assemble explicit water tables and maps from checked source data. The hydrologist studies the evidence and documents findings in {DOCS} with linked figures and references.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual compatible water observations may be repeatedly grouped and linked into study documents.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit aggregation and map rendering rules and native linked fields can perform that repeated work.
tasks.still_hard: Irregular monitoring coverage and changing development require scientific interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: Distinguish observed distribution from an unsupported account of its cause.

ambition.what: Reduce demonstrated repeated study tables and document links.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit water-data aggregations and map settings are deterministic; hydrological explanations and coverage assessment remain human judgement.

assumptions: Actual monitoring staff and project records produce source observations in normal work; s1 counts retrieval, actual site/time/unit/datum checks and aggregation mapping. New monitoring or modelling is not a free input and must be counted if needed.

S2 uses site ID, actual observation date and period, value and unit, datum, explicit development category and source revision under hydrologist-specified aggregation and map rules. Incompatible periods or datums remain exceptions, not freely normalised. Try native analysis views first; existing runtime yields no new saving.

Actual scientific study is s3 and actual documentation is s4, not folded into reading or conversation. Document savings cover checked figure/reference reuse only, not producing a scientific conclusion.

No water allocation, abstraction permit, operative development decision or external report send is hidden in ordinary saving. Actual formal release needs its real independent final-version authority and separate action. Same-system save share1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated. Shares are illustrative, not measured or derived from prompt priors.
unknowns: Which source periods and datums are actually compatible?
Which tables and document links are already native?
research_questions: Observe actual study preparation, explicit aggregation, hydrological reasoning and written documentation separately.

already_counted.description: Actual source verification, hydrological study, retained documentation and ordinary save remain in s1 and s3-s5.

incremental.description: Maintain site/time/datum mappings and linked-table rules beyond retained study checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:20 actual assembly points+24*.20=4.8 linked-document points=24.8 gross less3 upkeep=21.8. Low: irregular monitoring periods and incompatible datums leave16 of20 table/map assembly points manual or excluded;4 comparable points plus4.8 document links save, less3 upkeep=5.8. Source25, scientific study30 and save1 remain, as does19.2 documentation. An actual temporal/datum comparability case, unmeasured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare hydrological research reports or presentations with figures and appendices

steps.what: Collect actual completed research findings, original data and existing map layers, verify versions, units, permissions and figure metadata and specify the report's actual figures and appendix sources
inputs: Actual completed research, original datasets and real map layers
outputs: Verified findings and explicit figure, source and appendix mapping

steps.what: Render the explicitly selected actual research charts, illustrations and maps with fixed data, layer, legend, scale and unit settings
inputs: S1 verified datasets, map layers and explicit figure settings
outputs: Actual source-linked figures and missing-layer or metadata exceptions

steps.what: Assemble the selected figures, explicit appendix items and checked source references into the actual report or presentation structure
inputs: S2 actual figures and s1 explicit appendix and reference mapping
outputs: Report structure with linked figures, appendices and references

steps.what: Write the actual research narrative with a bounded wording helper using only verified findings and supplied source material, retaining scientific explanations and caveats
inputs: S1 actual verified findings and s3 populated report structure
outputs: Actual research report or presentation narrative with traceable claims

loop.purpose: Express actual established research findings clearly
loop.input: Verified findings, actual figures and supplied source passages
loop.output: Proposed narrative tied to actual figures and source passages
loop.check: Hydrologist checks every claim, number, unit, uncertainty and source against originals
loop.stop: Reject unsupported causal claims or references and write manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Explanatory prose varies while figures and explicit appendix assembly remain deterministic

steps.what: Check the complete actual report or presentation against research originals, including map meaning, legends, scale, numerical results, appendices, scientific conclusions and limitations
inputs: Complete actual report/presentation and original research evidence
outputs: Checked complete actual research report or presentation

steps.what: Save the complete actual working report or presentation in the same document system
inputs: Checked complete working report or presentation
outputs: Stored complete research report or presentation

tasks.design: Use {OTHER}, the actual research plotting and mapping environment, to render specified figures and {DOCS} to assemble actual appendices and source links. A bounded wording helper expresses supplied actual findings; the hydrologist checks the complete research meaning and saves the working deliverable.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual figures and appendices may require repeated manual production and insertion alongside narrative writing.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit plotting and document mappings are deterministic and supplied findings can support bounded wording drafts.
tasks.still_hard: Map meaning, causal claims and scientific uncertainty need original-research checks.
tasks.human_edge: Explain results without implying stronger evidence than the study provides.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicit research plots and document assembly are deterministic and bounded wording can use actual supplied findings; scientific checking remains human work.

assumptions: Actual prior research produces findings and datasets in the investigation/study workflow, not free uncounted work for the organisation. This task is report preparation; s1 counts retrieving originals, source/version/unit checks, map permissions, metadata preparation and explicit figure/appendix mapping. New scientific analysis is not smuggled into a supplied evidence pack.

S2 requires actual dataset and layer versions, selected variables, units, coordinate reference, map extent, legend and scale; s3 requires actual appendix item and reference IDs. Missing layers or metadata remain human exceptions. Try native plotting and linked report fields first. Existing rendered figures already in use yield no new human saving.

S4 does not generate new scientific findings or invent citations. Its retained18 points include real narrative production and claim-by-claim checking; s5 retains complete independent-in-time author checking, not self-approval.

The task prepares a complete working report or presentation, not an external submission or actual delivered talk. Real publication or sending requires its actual independent final-version authority and separate gated send; delivery of a presentation retains actual human delivery work if part of the real episode.

Ordinary same-system save share1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated with no saving or author self-approval. Shares are illustrative task work independent of prompt priors. Deduplicate actual research and report source preparation when the same action spans task descriptions.
unknowns: Which actual figure and appendix operations are manual?
Do required map layers and output metadata work in native report tools?
research_questions: Observe one actual report, counting original-source preparation, figure production, appendix assembly, narrative work and complete scientific checking separately.

already_counted.description: Actual source and output-metadata preparation, retained narrative production and checking, complete scientific check and ordinary save remain in s1 and s4-s6.

incremental.description: Maintain figure/appendix mappings and source-bound wording checks beyond retained per-report scientific review.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:20 actual figure points+10 appendix points+30*.40=12 prose points=42 gross less5 upkeep=37. Low: native plotting already produces all20 figure points and inconsistent appendix metadata leaves5 of10 assembly points manual; only5 appendix+12 prose points newly save, less5 upkeep=12. Source25, complete check14 and save1 remain, as does18 actual narrative work. A native-figure and appendix-metadata case, unmeasured.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Apply research to reduce pollution, disease, erosion or sedimentation impacts

steps.what: Read actual research findings and applicability limits and collect the real receiving-water, catchment and project context for the specific environmental impact problem
inputs: Actual research findings and real site/problem records
outputs: Verified research and application context

steps.what: Assess actual site conditions and constraints and define scientifically justified application options, explicit model inputs and comparison formulas for the real problem
inputs: Actual site evidence, research limits and real implementation constraints
outputs: Actual application options, verified parameters and explicit scenario-comparison specification

steps.what: Run the explicitly specified existing hydrological calculations for the actual selected options and assemble stated impact-comparison outputs with uncertainty and invalid-input flags
inputs: S2 actual verified inputs, selected options and explicit existing model/formulas
outputs: Actual option-comparison outputs and model-limit exceptions

steps.what: Apply the actual research by choosing site-appropriate hydrological measures and parameters, assessing model limits and deciding the technical recommendation and remaining evidence needs
inputs: Actual research, site evidence and checked option outputs
outputs: Actual site-specific technical application recommendation and limitations

steps.what: Write the actual working application plan with chosen measures, parameters, research justification, assumptions and unresolved conditions
inputs: Actual technical recommendation and verified source context
outputs: Actual written technical application plan

steps.what: Save the actual working plan in the same document system
inputs: Completed actual application plan
outputs: Stored actual working plan

tasks.design: Use {OTHER}, the actual hydrological modelling tools, to run explicitly chosen existing calculations for real site-specific application options. The hydrologist interprets actual applicability, chooses the technical measures and writes the application plan in {DOCS}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual selected options can require repeated model-input and comparison assembly.
tasks.enabler_now: Explicit existing model runs and output assembly can be scripted deterministically after scientific inputs are chosen.
tasks.still_hard: A research finding may not transfer to the actual catchment or exposure pathway.
tasks.human_edge: Choose defensible site-specific measures and state when evidence is insufficient.

ambition.what: Reduce demonstrated repeated option calculation within scientific application work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: explicitly specified existing hydrological calculations can be run and compared deterministically while research transfer and measure selection remain scientific judgement.

assumptions: Representative actual scientific application episode producing a site-specific technical plan, not a measured mixture of every pollution, disease, erosion and sedimentation intervention. Actual research staff and site owners produce source findings and records; s1 counts retrieval and applicability reading, s2 actual site assessment, parameter capture and formula specification. No ready-to-run model or clean site feed is free.

S3 uses actual option ID, model/version, explicit boundary conditions, site parameters and units and selected output metric under the hydrologist's existing validated formula/model. It does not invent a model, transfer research automatically or choose a measure. Missing or out-of-domain inputs remain manual scientific work. Try native scenario tools first; existing automatic runs earn no new runtime benefit.

S4 is actual scientific application and s5 its actual written plan, split before estimating saving. The task does not imply physical construction, dosing, water-system control, permit adoption or a public-health decision by software. Any real implementation action or written handover requires the actual final-version authority and separate action before extending this episode; physical implementation labour is not claimed as saved.

Ordinary same-system save share1 is negligible, fully retained and ungated, with no author self-approval or saving. Shares are illustrative task effort independent of prompt priors and do not extrapolate to an unmeasured intervention mix.
unknowns: Which actual option-run and comparison operations are manual today?
Does the existing model apply to the real catchment and problem?
research_questions: Observe a real scientific application episode, counting site/input preparation, repeat calculation, actual measure choice and plan writing separately.

already_counted.description: Actual research and context checks, site assessment and input specification, measure choice, application-plan writing and ordinary save remain in s1, s2 and s4-s6.

incremental.description: Maintain actual model input/output mappings and regression examples beyond retained scientific applicability checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: High:20 actual repeated option-run/assembly points save less4 upkeep=16. Low: the existing model accepts only a subset of the site's boundary conditions, leaving13 of20 option-calculation points requiring manual scientific adaptation or exclusion;7 compatible repeat-run points save, less4 upkeep=3. All20 research reading,25 site/input reasoning,25 application judgement,9 actual plan writing and1 save remain. A model-domain and boundary-condition compatibility case, unmeasured.
